forms.label: Resource commons
forms.description: A shared resource that can be used up, governed by the people who depend on it.

forms.label: Knowledge commons
forms.description: Shared knowledge, data or methods that anyone may use and a community maintains.

forms.label: Infrastructure commons
forms.description: Shared tools: open-source software, open standards and protocols.

forms.label: Enterprise
forms.description: A business or cooperative whose incentives are aligned with the outcome it sells.

forms.label: Public
forms.description: Provided or convened through government at any level.

formsNote: Claude's synthesis, not a published scheme. A record may carry more than one form.

initiativeStages.label: Idea
initiativeStages.description: A possible way to act on it.

initiativeStages.label: Proposal
initiativeStages.description: Written up, with a named owner.

initiativeStages.label: Small test
initiativeStages.description: Tried for real, at small scale.

initiativeStages.label: Running
initiativeStages.description: Operating, with status from its owner.

structureStatuses.label: Partial
structureStatuses.description: Exists in limited form; insufficient scope, scale or design maturity.

structureStatuses.label: Needed
structureStatuses.description: The need is clear; an adequate structure does not yet exist.

structureStatuses.label: Speculative
structureStatuses.description: Potentially needed; the requirement is not yet fully defined or demonstrated.

evidentiaryStatuses.label: Reasonable extension
evidentiaryStatuses.description: Follows from the evidence, but not shown directly.

evidentiaryStatuses.label: Speculation
evidentiaryStatuses.description: Our own conjecture, labelled as such.

evidentiaryStatusesNote: The three levels are the book's. The one-line descriptions are Claude's wording. The status attaches to a claim, not to a source.
